title: Learning Implicit Constitutive Laws for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Videos
abstract: arXiv:2608.22102v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present GCA (Gaussian Constitutive Alignment), a framework for learning implicit constitutive laws from monocular dynamic video of deformable objects represented by 3D Gaussians. Given a static multi-view scan for geometric initialization, our method learns intrinsic physical dynamics solely from a single fixed-viewpoint video of the moving object. Existing implicit methods often suffer from local minima under noisy supervision and lack physical interpretability, while explicit approaches rely on predefined constitutive equations, limiting generalizability and becoming unstable in monocular settings. To address these challenges, our framework unifies LoRA-based adaptation with two key alignment modules. First, we propose Rank-based Depth-Geometric Anchors (RDGA) to establish robust geometric constraints from monocular dynamic observations via scale-invariant rank-based depth alignment, reducing the reliance on unreliable pixel-level

translated_title: 从单目视频学习动态3D高斯泼溅的隐式本构定律
translated_abstract: 我们提出了GCA（高斯本构对齐），一个从可变形物体的单目动态视频中学习隐式本构定律的框架，该框架使用3D高斯表示。给定静态多视角扫描用于几何初始化，我们的方法仅从单一固定视角的移动物体视频中学习内在物理动力学。现有的隐式方法在噪声监督下常陷入局部最小值，且缺乏物理可解释性，而显式方法依赖预定义的本构方程，限制了泛化能力并在单目设置中变得不稳定。为解决这些挑战，我们的框架将基于LoRA的适应与两个关键对齐模块统一起来。首先，我们提出了基于秩的深度几何锚点（RDGA），通过尺度不变的基于秩的深度对齐，从单目动态观察中建立稳健的几何约束，减少对不可靠像素级数据的依赖。
tldr: 本文提出GCA框架，通过LoRA适应和秩基深度几何锚点，从单目视频中学习可变形物体的隐式本构定律，克服了隐式方法的局部最小值和显式方法的泛化限制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GCA, a framework that learns implicit constitutive laws for deformable objects from monocular videos via LoRA adaptation and rank-based depth geometric anchors, overcoming local minima in implicit methods and generalization limits in explicit approaches.
